body:
Hi @iphydf

Long time no see. It seems like you want to restart development on qTox.

If you (and a team?) are able to continue the work I'd be happy to redirect qTox/qTox to here.

Let me know what you think about it.

comment_data.body:
Hi :) yeah, we've started working on it again. I'd like to revive it properly. We're aiming for a 1.18 release pretty soon. The team is mainly me, @Green-Sky, and @robinlinden at the moment. Maybe more people will want to join.

For the release, we should probably point the download page on qtox.github.io at the new URLs.
@sudden6 I think we're ready for this change now.

> Hi :) yeah, we've started working on it again. I'd like to revive it properly. We're aiming for a 1.18 release pretty soon. The team is mainly me, [@Green-Sky](https://github.com/Green-Sky), and [@robinlinden](https://github.com/robinlinden) at the moment. Maybe more people will want to join.
> 
> For the release, we should probably point the download page on qtox.github.io at the new URLs.

No Law Enforcement please :D
I think this is done, close?
https://qtox.github.io is still not pointing to TokTok, despite the https://github.com/qTox/qTox-Website/pull/43 being merged. It looks like the changes weren't published.

As of date of posting, this is still PARTIALLY working in production (more info and download links in the body of https://qtox.github.io/ go to the correct GitHub repo, but the top menu items do not) and can NOT be closed ⛔

title: Redirect qTox/qTox to Toktok/qTox
